{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} Up to a {c_number}{SF_0}%{/c} chance when dealing damage to a {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}, Immobilized or Stunned enemy that a {c_important}Lightning Bolt{/c} also hits dealing {c_number}{payload:DAMAGE_TOOLTIP_ONLY}{/c} damage.
